embedding_recommendation.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio OpenAI-compatible API

retrieval_policy.secondary_usage: Only as a discovery lead or weak analogy; never as decisive evidence.
retrieval_policy.golden_definition: Original video or transcript independently checked with source locators, factual fields, reasoning chain and outcome when available.

quality_boundary: Fifty-two method cards are internally reviewed and twenty-five demonstration cases are marked golden (cross-checked against locally stored timestamped Douyin consultation transcripts with source locators). A 2026-07-22 batch extracted from 20 Douyin transcripts (开店品类 001-017, 选址商圈 018-020) added the bulk of these; case numbers are participant-stated and time-anchored but none has a verified follow-up outcome. Sixteen earlier cases remain detailed secondary notes and are excluded from decisive retrieval.
rights_boundary: Only short structured summaries and public source links are distributed. Third-party transcripts, audio, video, likeness, voice and unlicensed repository case text are not bundled.
